obligations.target: Prove that input fields for entering parameter values are rendered alongside API calls that accept parameters
obligations.reason: Unit testing the main page rendering logic verifies that parameter inputs are generated for endpoints supporting parameters.

obligations.target: Prove that an API call executes using a user-supplied parameter value and returns the resulting output
obligations.reason: Unit testing verifies parameter extraction and execution logic handles single user-supplied values accurately.

obligations.target: Prove that an API call executes incorporating multiple supplied parameter values and displays the result
obligations.reason: Unit testing verifies request handling and parameter parsing when multiple inputs are supplied simultaneously.

obligations.target: Prove that missing required parameters trigger a visible requirement indication and prevent call execution
obligations.reason: Unit testing input validation logic ensures required parameters are enforced before triggering API execution.

obligations.target: Prove that updating parameter values and re-running the API call uses the updated input and displays new results
obligations.reason: Unit testing verifies that subsequent executions correctly use updated parameter state instead of stale values.

obligations.target: Prove that parameter values containing spaces and special characters are properly handled and executed
obligations.reason: Unit testing validates character encoding and handling for parameter values containing special characters.
